links.outcome: AMD staging and referral F1 of VLMs compared with ophthalmologists
links.effect: RetinaVLM-Specialist outperformed medical VLMs and ChatGPT-4o in AMD staging (F1: 0.63 vs. 0.33) and referral (0.67 vs. 0.50), comparable to junior ophthalmologists.
links.quote: The resulting model, RetinaVLM-Specialist, significantly outperforms foundation medical VLMs and ChatGPT-4o in AMD disease staging (F1: 0.63 vs. 0.33) and referral (0.67 vs. 0.50), achieving performance comparable to junior ophthalmologists.

unlisted_practices: Specialist-designed training curriculum for adapting vision-language models to clinical tasks

screen.reason: Evaluates domain-specific VLM training curricula and compares the model against general foundation models and clinicians in offline benchmarking and an expert reader study.
